item.title: Deadly shooting under investigation in Asheville
item.description: ASHEVILLE, N.C. (WSPA) - Asheville police are investigating a shooting which left one person dead early Saturday morning. According to Asheville Police Department, at around 12:20 a.m. officers were called to Granada Street in reference to a gunshot victim.
